race.comment: NEWY (2) has been very good in his two runs this time in work, both over 1200m at Port Macquarie. Should box-seat from the inside gate and will be tough to hold out when called upon. UNDER TWENTY TWO (8) has had a new lease on life since landing in the Neil Godbolt stable this prep. Showed early pace then battled on bravely for third under 61kgs over this trip at Kempsey recently. Gets some weight relief today and couldn't ask for a better barrier. Serious contender. YOUWROTEUPONIT (7) started at $1.65 but was no match for the winner last start 1318m Class 2 at Coffs Harbour. Drops 2.5kgs and will appreciate the slightly shorter trip. POLYMER (4) has disappointed in two appearances this prep but is better than that.
